**Categories read off the examples**
- Opinion: silly, terrible, good, nice, awful, ridiculous, wonderful, lovely.
- Size: little, tiny, big, massive, large, normal-size.
- Age: new, old, ancient, archaic, old-fashioned, brand-new.
- Shape: prismlike, square, circular, rectangular, pyramidal, spherical.
- Color: violet, white, blue, cyan, and so on.
- Origin: thai, filipino, iranian, indonesian, bangladeshi, and so on.
- Material: wood, cloth, paper, fiberglass, glass, and so on.
- Purpose: smoking, drinking, eating, snorkeling, walking, and so on.

**Order constraints from the examples**
- (14) plastic egyptian, (27) wood chinese, (46) fiberglass vietnamese, (79) glass bangladeshi: material < origin.
- (34) turkish old green: origin < age < color.
- (30) old-fashioned typing, (49) new smoking, (54) archaic snorkeling: age < purpose.
- (77) cardboard typing lovely: purpose < opinion, and material < purpose.
- (2) silly violet, (85) nice red: opinion < color.
- (29) little square, (66) small circular, (74) enormous triangular: size < shape.

Chaining these gives material < origin < age < purpose < opinion < color, with size < shape.

**Placement of size and shape**
No example fixes where size and shape sit relative to the other categories, so the data alone cannot decide it. Six options (B, D, E, F, H, I) put them after color, which is consistent with all constraints above. Only G puts them before age. I took "after color" as the intended order because six options agree on it, so G is treated as the incorrect one. This is an assumption, not a derivation from the sentences.

**Options**
- A: shape before size, which violates size < shape. Wrong.
- B: material, origin, age, purpose, opinion, color, size, shape. Correct.
- C: shape comes first and material (paper) comes after origin, which violates material < origin. Wrong.
- D: age, purpose, opinion, color, size, shape. Correct.
- E: material, origin, age, purpose, opinion, color. Correct.
- F: material, origin, age, purpose, opinion, color, size. Correct.
- G: size and shape come before age, which conflicts with the "after color" placement. Wrong.
- H: origin, age, purpose, opinion, color, size, shape. Correct.
- I: material, origin, age, purpose, opinion, color, shape. Correct.
- J: shape before size, which violates size < shape. Wrong.
